sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 213

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 213:1
items.html: Because of the sin of the First Man, the nine lower [Sefirot] of the Nukva fell and clothed in the Nukva of the Klipot, and she was built into a complete Partzuf of ten Sefirot, and the ZON of the Klipa became in the aspect of face to face. (Item 234).
